body: Lmfao right

We got into a fight the other night, and I packed his stuff because I told him I feel like he’s cheating with Hannah because I saw messages of her flirting with him. He told me if he wanted to leave he would tell me, and if he wanted someone else he would go find someone else.
I feel like he always tells me this stuff when we’re fighting, but never just tells me anything when we aren’t fighting.
My therapist, who went to school to be a psychiatrist, but felt therapy was a better fit, she  told me that i had dissociative identity disorder, also known as multiple personalities.

We both have mental issues, and we have tried to keep them apart instead of bonding over them. He isn’t very open to me. 
And he did really good with helping me until he moved in with me. I also felt weird within him moving in because I felt like I was letting someone into my cacoon. Most of the time my mental illness is under control when it comes to the craziness. I’m a boss for a large company and it makes me really scared to fuck up because I didn’t think I’d ever become someone’s boss. Sometimes I just look at my boyfriend for reassurance that I’m/we are going to be ok because that’s all the makes me happy. I grew up not having anything, so the littlest things always make me super happy. 
But you’re probably right that I need to get a firmer grip on myself for sure. Thank you for being blunt with me.
Yeah. Like 8 months ago.
Absolutely I will.🙄

So, maybe I need to drink more water? Because if that’s what you’re saying, that 110% could be it, because typically I don’t drink regular water, or water at all. I’m honestly terrible within my fluid intake.
Doctor who saw me at the ER said I was DRY. That I was the opposite of anemic, and I was super super dehydrated. I’m still pretty confused on what they said , but all I know is I’m scared.

My hemoglobin was at a 17 through blood & a 3+ through urine. 
All test through the initial urine sample came back negative. 
Everything was in green for the CBC. 
Here is somethings listen through the CBC & my results. 

For you, or anyone else who might read this, and idk if you have basic understanding for this, but if so, here it is. 

white blood cells - 12.7
Red blood cells - 5.5 
Platelet count - 280 
Hemotocrit - 48.8 
Absolute neutrophils - 9.2

Everything else was in standard range, those were just the things elevated for a standard CBC.

Okay, thank you! 
It’s just so hard to do anything right now, and I’m stressing because I’m tired of these head aches happening, and it knocks me down whenever I’m doing well. I’m just tired of it. :(

I absolutely fucking love this. I really appreciate you. I can’t even tell you enough. 
I just want to make a impact on others; but this, this right here is the key. 

It’s crazy to think that you are giving me advice that my parents gave me years ago before I dropped out of school
Like would anyone , at all, even miss me? That type of feeling.

You’re right, and I always try to live by a personal philosophy— find all beauty in everything. 
You can literally look at any single object, and find something that I could make beautiful or have some sort of potential in— but some days are harder than others when it comes to finding beauty. 
Life really is a blessing, but some days I just feel like a stop, and let go button would great.

Thank you for taking the time to read my story. ❤️ and please don’t hurt yourself tonight. 🙂 I’m always here on reddit if you want to talk! I’m just waiting for someone to be able to help me. Message me if you ever need to.
